reviews.author: Jeffrey Polston
reviews.text: Barry and his team at Auto Tech are the most efficient and very kind mechanics that I know… And I’ve been working with these guys for about 5+ years now I cannot say how much I enjoy them… Take your car there and they will take care of you… I’ve turned on a few of my friends to Auto Tech because it is worth it. Trust me… They care about what they do and they do really really really great work five star Auto Tech! Thank you.

reviews.author: Anita Myers
reviews.text: Long story short, I purchased a 2015 Mercedes Benz 450GL last month under advisement and referral I take it to Auto- Tech in Little River well when I went to retrieve my the owner Barry said oh you still have an alert it read low on fuel. When you get quality service it costs but worth it. Definitely recommended Auto-tech for foreign vehicles.

reviews.author: Chuck Wimer
reviews.text: This place is exceptional!!! I had a wiring problem with my Range Rover and I was expecting a huge bill. Barry promptly did the work and the price was reasonable. I will highly recommend this place to my social circle!!!

reviews.author: Jessica LaBuda
reviews.text: Barry and Andrew are great!!! You can trust them to do the right thing for you! I have been there multiple times and I am so impressed by their business!!! Just give them a call! Easy to talk to, friendly, and know their stuff! I totally recommend them!

reviews.author: e2studio Tutoring and ACT Prep
reviews.text: Barry is an honest, reliable, communicative, and helpful mechanic. We have had several issues with dealerships in the area. He discovered an issue with my VW GTI computer where five other mechanics including multiple visits to VW dealership could not properly diagnose the cause of a running fan. We were fortunate to find Barry. He is our go to guy!

reviews.author: Danica Cale
reviews.text: It is hard to find a reliable new mechanic after moving here from out of state. The customer service is exceptional, they go above and beyond to help out customers in a timely fashion. My repairs are always completed correctly and efficiently. I will continue to go here for all of my auto needs.

reviews.author: Bill Hatfield
reviews.text: Barry and his son,Andrew, are exceptional technicians and I am very pleased with how they care for my 2016 Ferrari California T.

reviews.author: Lamar Brabham
reviews.text: My wife brought her BMW to Barry because her head rest wouldn’t go down. He offered to take a look at it when she called to see if that was something he could work on. He pushed the power button on the side of the seat and it receded. He would not let her pay him for it. We have 2 BMW’s and he has two customers for life. Honest car repair shops are very hard to find. Would highly recommend to anyone!

reviews.author: Joe Gneiser
reviews.text: Terrific experience with Barry and Andrew. Very efficient and extremely polite service. Mini Cooper fans looking for a great place for servicing your vehicle: this is the place!

reviews.author: Romeo-Cezar Stan
reviews.text: I was impressed with the personable service Barry provided, we arranged for him to pick up my vehicle and perform the work. Upon completion, Barry promptly called me and picked me up from work, returning the vehicle to me. Granted, it's only about a half mile from his shop, but courteous service remains courteous service. Will not use the "big guys" anymore but have become a loyal customer.

reviews.author: Oscar Bestess
reviews.text: MUST READ. Got a price for A/C repair. Being out of town he tried to take advantage of me. I called Blacks Tire and got the job done for nearly half the price he quoted me. IN RESPONSE TO YOUR REBUTTAL. You also gave me a price for a rebuilt A/C installation and it was still $400 more than I paid at Blacks Tire. They installed a brand new unit not rebuilt. And they installed a new tensioner so take that into account also which would have even more than your quote.

reviews.author: Philip Rule
reviews.text: A prominent local shop recommend Auto Tech after they told me they would not even look at my 2003 Range Rover. It was no problem for Barry whose logical approach diagnosed and corrected the problem quickly and for a fair price. Auto Tech will be my shop of choice whenever I need assistance while in Myrtle Beach. Thanks Barry

reviews.author: Doria M
reviews.text: Great Professional and friendly staff. Brought our Mercedes there several times and always get the job done.

reviews.author: Rabon Brown
reviews.text: Super quick fluid change service at a very fair price! Experienced, friendly and knowledgeable owner. Will certainly use Auto-Tech again.

reviews.author: Teemu Savinainen
reviews.text: My alternator broke while in North Myrtle Beach and they were able to find the part and fix it in 1 day for a good price.

reviews.author: Scan Randall
reviews.text: I've had them do a couple of things for me and I can tell you Barry and Andrew are old school honest with fair pricing. I highly recommend Auto Tech

reviews.author: mickey wilber
reviews.text: They were able to get me in the quickly. No wait,. They diagnosed and fixed the problem and sent me on my way. Very friendly and professional. I will use them again and recommend to anyone with auto problems

reviews.author: Chaqutte Gause
reviews.text: Took my BMW here because of a water link he(Barry) charge me 1260.00 to fix the problem and I still have the same problem he (Barry) call me up and said to me he thinks he found the problem and it would be another $1000.00. Never again will I take my car there just for him to THINK he know what the problem is..

reviews.author: Kris Thompson
reviews.text: Save your time and just avoid this shop. They had my car for a very long time, there was damage to it and put many miles on it just to not fix it in 6 weeks. After getting it back they told me it would be $5,000 to fix and and I went to another shop in myrtle beach. They fixed it there for $1,500 and I got it back in one week.

reviews.author: D. Strauss
reviews.text: Barry has been my mechanic for years, I am grateful to have found him and I can depend on his honesty, consistency and dependable service.

reviews.author: Rick McCall
reviews.text: I had a wheel that no one could remove. A wheel stud was seized. I was referred to Barry at Auto Zone and he was able to remove the wheel. I highly recommend!

reviews.author: Georgia Plum
reviews.text: Absolutely wonderful men! Very helpful, knowledgeable and capable. Will return for all of my maintenance needs and any future mechanical issues .

reviews.author: Tasty Tee
reviews.text: I had a greT experience at AutoTech as usual…. Great customer service. Great conversation with Xena… she is the cutie pie!!!!

reviews.author: Karen Tedor
reviews.text: If you have a foreign car this is the place to go. They were patient listened carefully and were reasonable.

reviews.author: Steve Gravius
reviews.text: Barry replaced my front axle and rear brake sensor. Great price and more importantly the car is running great as well. I’d recommend this shop to anyone looking for good and honest mechanics.

reviews.author: Scott Starbuck
reviews.text: My 2015 BMW M235I broke down while on vacation last week. After getting a recommendation from the first shop that I called, Auto-Tech immediately had me bring it in. Within minutes they confirmed my suspicion and ordered the necessary part. Had the repairs completed in plenty of time to return home.
